主要内容: On March 29, 2019, Geospace Technologies Corporation entered into a Sixth Amendment to its Loan Agreement, which amended the unencumbered liquid assets covenant to reduce the minimum threshold from $10,000,000 to $5,000,000 and include unencumbered liquid assets held outside the United States. The Company must maintain unencumbered liquid assets with an aggregate market value of not less than $5 million. The Amendment also added a requirement to maintain tangible net worth of not less than $140 million.
